name: Parle Monaco
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (maida), refined oils (palmolein and palm), sugar, raising agents [503(ii), 500(ii), 341(i)], iodised salt (2.25%), invert sugar syrup, yeast, acidity regulators (270, 296), flour treatment agents [223, 1101(ii), 1100(i)], emulsifier of vegetable origin [472e]. Contains added flavours (artificial flavouring substance - butter).
